title: TG#1 second photo: use frame_paths[1] (frame 2) instead of frame_paths[3] (frame 4)
author: the operator
shipping_definition: TG#1 second photo shows the vehicle when the most recent ring-buffer frame (frame 4, frame_paths[3]) has the vehicle already out of frame. Switch to frame_paths[1] (frame 2, second-oldest in 6s window) where motion was strongest at alert time.
operator_decisions_captured: Operator 2026-09-12: yes it's a very small change instead of frame four I want frame two.
Operator 2026-09-12: vehicle is sometimes not in the second image because frame 4 is the most recent frame and the vehicle has already passed through / out of view.

Frame indexing convention (verified from infra/gate.py:847-850): frame_paths[0] = frame_1, frame_paths[1] = frame_2, frame_paths[2] = frame_3, frame_paths[3] = frame_4. Frame 2 = ~4.5s into the 6s ring window.

stories.title: TG#1 second photo uses frame_paths[1] (frame 2)
stories.description: Modify infra/alert_artifacts.py to set full_frame_path = frame_paths[1] (the 2nd frame in the 4-frame ring window, ~4.5s before webhook). Update all 4 docstring references and the one code line. Update test_alert_artifacts.py:94 to assert the 2nd path. Update V2-024 PRD line 63 + V2-027 PRD 4 references. NO new files. NO schema change. Pure frame-index swap.

scope_exclusions: No change to TG#2 photo set (crops crop_a + crop_b, already correct).
No change to the gate's own frame indexing (gate.py:847-850 uses 0-3 for frame_1..frame_4; that mapping stays).
No change to frame_capture or ring buffer (the 4 frames are still captured the same way; only which one is used as full_frame_path changes).
No change to TG#1 caption (already correct: composite + frame_2).
